items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Jonesy was Duke's man... I remember one night we were on this pullman train... there was Jonesy, sitting there, gasping

ctx.x: Jonesy was Duke's man. Jonesy was a young fellow who Duke got from the Cotton Club. He was a bus boy up at the Cotton Club, and he got very friendly with Duke and Duke's band when they were up at the Cotton Club, and when Duke left the Cotton Club, he left and went along with Duke as, you know, a valet, a band boy or whatever. So Jonesy was along, you know, and whatever you wanted, just tell Jonesy. You'd say, "Jonesy, get my big bag." That's all you had to say and Jonesy would get your big bag and put it in the…
to -- and they'd even carry your instruments for you.
